verdict.rationale: Sentry ships Seer, a built-in AI debugging agent and code reviewer. Users can hand it root-cause analysis and suggested code fixes through Autofix, and Seer can launch Cursor Cloud Agents or other coding agents to generate fixes and open pull requests. Its scope is limited to debugging and code review, and it needs a separate subscription. Missing for 10: delegation beyond debugging/code-review tasks (e.g. general product tasks like configuring alerts or dashboards via the in-product assistant), Seer available without a paid add-on, independent or hands-on corroboration of Seer's effectiveness.
